High Court Of Judicature At Bombay
 Bench At Aurangabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Advocate for Applicant in Aba-2260/2025 : Mr. Ostwal Abhaykumar Dilip
 App for Respondents/State : Mr. D. J. Patil

... 
 Coram : Mehroz K. Pathan, J.
 Date : 1st April 2026

Per Court :
 Order in Anticipatory Bail Application No. 2260/2025 :
 1.

After hearing the matter for some time, it appears from the  record that the Applicant can be directed to join the investigation, as  the other accused, namely Santosh Namdeo Kadam, who is also  alleged to have executed the sale deed in favour of other persons  instead of the Complainant in respect of Survey No. 78/1, is already  protected by this Court vide order dated 11.12.2025 passed in ABA  No. 2202 of 2025. I am, therefore, inclined to protect the Applicant  2 916.ABA-2260-2025.doc until the investigation papers are received, however, to certain conditions.

Hence the following order :
 ORDER (a) In the event of arrest of the Applicant - Sunil Natha Vairagar in connection with Crime No.840/2025 registered with M.I.D.C. Police Station, District Ahilyanagar for the offences punishable under Sections 406, 417, 420, 465, 466, 467, 468, 471 read with Sections 34, 120-B of Sachin Rohidas Shinde vs The State Of Maharashtra And Another on 1 April, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/191942834/
1 the Indian Penal Code, 1860, he be released on bail on furnishing P.R. bond of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousands) with two solvent sureties in the like amount, on the following conditions :
(b) The Applicant is directed to attend M.I.D.C. Police Station, District Ahilyanagar on 8th, 9th, 15th, 16th, 22nd and 23rd April of 2026 between 11:00 am. to 01:00 pm.
and co-operate with the Investigating Officer.
